import openpyxl

# 4. Check formatting / fill colors
print("=== 4. FORMATTING CHECK ===")

def describe_fill(cell):
    f = cell.fill
    if f.fgColor and f.fgColor.rgb and f.fgColor.rgb != '00000000':
        return f"fgColor={f.fgColor.rgb}, type={f.patternType}"
    if f.start_color and f.start_color.rgb and f.start_color.rgb != '00000000':
        return f"startColor={f.start_color.rgb}, type={f.patternType}"
    return f"no fill (patternType={f.patternType}, fg={f.fgColor.rgb if f.fgColor else 'None'})"

# Check C11:L20 yellow fill

    for col in range(3, 13):  # C-L
        cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col)
        cl = get_column_letter(col)
        fill_desc = describe_fill(cell)

            yellow_count += 1

            non_yellow.append(f"{cl}{row}: {fill_desc}")
